cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a windswept coastal bluff with a low grassy path and an empty kite-flying area — reading the changing wind before letting a simple diamond kite rise higher; an underground subway platform — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a private orbital passenger cabin with an oval window and a fabric sleeping hammock — taking a quiet break while letting a folded paper star float gently between her hands; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — kneeling on the ground; a dim jazz bar with a grand piano — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a neon-lit bar counter with backlit bottles — seated sideways on a stool or bench
